titulo: Quiz — The last morning, in order
subtitulo: Checkout, storage, tip, and the close
introPt: A traveller checks out hours before a night flight. Listen for the storage ticket, the voluntary tip and the final goodbye.
cenario: The room is closed mid-morning; the flight leaves that night.

dialogo.es: Todo bien, gracias. Vengo a hacer el check-out.
dialogo.pt: All good, thanks. I'm here to check out.

dialogo.es: ¿Puedo dejar mi maleta aquí hasta la tarde?
dialogo.pt: Can I leave my suitcase here until the afternoon?

dialogo.es: Sí, claro. Aquí tiene su comprobante.
dialogo.pt: Yes, of course. Here's your claim ticket.

dialogo.es: ¿Le gustaría dejar alguna propina para la camarista?
dialogo.pt: Would you like to leave a tip for the housekeeper?

dialogo.es: Sí, ya la dejé en la habitación.
dialogo.pt: Yes, I already left it in the room.
Thank you very much. See you.

perguntas.pergunta: Why ask to leave the suitcase rather than carrying it all day?
opcoes: Checkout time does not extend to match a late flight
It is cheaper than a taxi
perguntas.explica: The room's checkout clock and the flight time are unrelated; storage solves the gap.

opcoes: Gets the bag back without an argument
perguntas.explica: It is the same receipt logic as B14 and B15, applied to stored luggage.

opcoes: No, it is a voluntary local custom
perguntas.explica: Unlike an automatic bill charge, this tip is optional and its amount is the traveller's choice.

perguntas.pergunta: What does 'ya la dejé en la habitación' mean here?
opcoes: The tip was already left in the room
perguntas.explica: It confirms the tip was already handled before the desk conversation.

perguntas.pergunta: How does the traveller close the whole stay?
opcoes: With gracias and hasta luego, the same close used all module
perguntas.explica: The course closes with the same two-word pattern it opened with.
